bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
branch="fix/video-chat-two-topic-pinned-doorways-20261123"
source="artifacts/bot/scripts/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.ts"
stage="deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch"
git cat-file -e "FETCH_HEAD:$source"
mkdir -p "$stage"
test ! -e "artifacts/bot/scripts/.video-two-topic-host-20261123.ts"
git show "FETCH_HEAD:$source" > "artifacts/bot/scripts/.video-two-topic-host-20261123.ts"
trap 'rm -f artifacts/bot/scripts/.video-two-topic-host-20261123.ts' EXIT
if test -x node_modules/.bin/esbuild; then
 node_modules/.bin/esbuild artifacts/bot/scripts/.video-two-topic-host-20261123.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --packages=bundle --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile="$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
else
 echo ESBUILD_UNAVAILABLE >&2; exit 43
fi
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_DRY_RUN_PASS
